title: No test proves weight, steps or sleep from Health Connect stay on the phone
what: The app promises body weight, steps and sleep read from Health Connect never leave the phone. No test checks that any of them stays out of what is sent to the gym, a trainer, the server or the AI, or that sleep is kept out of muscle readiness. A change could start sending them and every test would still pass. (The risk of it happening is FN-L4-phone-native-02.)
expected: A test that builds every gym, trainer, server and AI send and fails if a weight, step or sleep value read from Health Connect is in it.
fix_line: Add one test that checks nothing read from Health Connect is in any send.

title: After Erase all data, no test checks reminders, Health Connect, widgets or shortcuts
what: The phone test only checks that the welcome screen shows after the erase. Nothing checks that workout reminders stop, that Health Connect sending is off, that widgets go blank and stop offering Resume, or that app-icon shortcuts lose old routine names. The fault that this clean-up can be skipped (FN-A5-phone-native-4-01) would not be caught.
expected: A test that erases with reminders, Health Connect, a widget and a shortcut in place, then checks each is cleared.
fix_line: Add a test that runs the after-erase clean-up and checks reminders, Health Connect, widgets and shortcuts.

title: The workout reminder's own words and what it shows on a locked phone are never tested
what: Tests check the days and times reminders are set for, but never the notification itself: 'Time to train', the next routine's name, the fallback line, that nothing personal like body weight shows on the lock screen, that a tap opens the Workout tab, or that setting reminders makes no server call.
expected: A test that builds the reminder notification and checks its title, its routine line, that it holds nothing else, and that no network call is made.
fix_line: Add a test of the reminder notification's words and contents.

title: The weight and steps rows on the Health Connect page are never opened in a test
what: No phone flow taps 'Read my weight' or 'Show my steps'. Their captions, refused and failed words are checked only for being whole sentences, not their text. Nothing checks the 'added' line appears only when something was added, that a failed read does not start the 10-minute wait, that steps refresh on return, that phone and watch steps are not counted twice, or that weigh-ins already added stay after Stop.
expected: A phone flow or screen test for both rows: on, refused, failed, Stop, and the result lines with their exact words.
fix_line: Add a screen test for the weight and steps rows and check their exact words.

title: Health Connect sending: Stop, a refused or missing Health Connect, Not now and a second tap are never tested on screen
what: The phone flow checks Connect, the On caption and one past send. It never presses Stop or Turn on, never sees 'Nothing opened?', 'not available on this phone' or the Stopped words (checked only as whole sentences), never presses 'Not now', and never taps send twice. No test checks a workout lands in Health Connect only once.
expected: Screen tests for Stop and Turn on, the refused and missing states, Not now, a double tap, and a resend that does not double a workout.
fix_line: Add phone tests for Stop, Turn on, refused, missing, Not now and a double tap.

title: The 'What my gym can see' switches are never flipped in a test, and Busy machines is never checked
what: The phone flow only opens the page and reads the trainer caption. No test flips a switch, goes offline, or checks the new-member defaults on screen. The 'Share which machines I use' switch and its showing only for a gym with Busy machines have no test. The flow's comment says the trainer switch is on by default while the app starts it off, and the flow does not check either.
expected: A phone flow that checks each switch's default, flips it on and off (also offline) and checks the gym's side changes, including Busy machines.
fix_line: Add a phone flow that flips each gym sharing switch and checks the default.

title: Changing reminder days or time, switching reminders off, and the Try again buttons are never tested
what: The phone flow switches reminders on and reads the caption, but never picks a day, changes the time, or switches them off to see the set reminders cancelled. The failed-reminder and failed-widget-start 'Try again' buttons are checked only as words. No test checks an open workout stops today's reminder, or that a discarded workout brings it back.
expected: Tests that change days and time, switch off and see nothing scheduled, press each Try again, and cover open and discarded workouts.
fix_line: Add tests for changing and stopping reminders and for both Try again buttons.
